title: Original M6 final core composition with actual code and actual costs

spec.name: M6.Final.counting_correct
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Final.BP), M6.Final.Admissible N a b → M6.Final.CountingCorrect N a b
spec.guidance: For the two raw scaling fields, rw [M6.ActualTransfer.boundary_trace_inputs N a b hs P] (respectively character_trace_inputs), change M6.ActualCounts.boundaryInputSum N a b P = _ (respectively signedInputSum), and exact M6.ActualCounts.boundary_pinned_sum N a b ha hb P (respectively cycle_pinned_sum). These explicit raw formulas guarantee exact divisibility. Use ActualResult normalized/Q identities and ActualCounts.logical_card to rewrite Q_total. Unfold LX/BX/CX aliases; actual logicalWords is definitional difference. Derive degree<N from span<N once. Every antecedent used comes from Admissible; retain original goal. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Final.parameters_correct
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Final.BP), M6.Final.Admissible N a b → M6.Final.ParametersCorrect N a b
spec.guidance: Use actual cardinality and encoded_dimension with degree bounds, f_le_order and corrected logicals_nonempty_iff. Parentheses in iff are essential. Every antecedent used comes from Admissible; retain original goal. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Final.answer_correct
spec.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Final.BP), M6.Final.Admissible N a b → M6.Final.AnswerCorrect N a b
spec.guidance: Use ActualResult.solve_exact plus actual logicals_nonempty_iff and ActualCSS.common_quantum_distance. Pinned.distance_spec turns exact minimum returned by solve into actual CSS quantumDistance. J_logical_iff and Flatten.J_weight supply Z witness. For existence, solve!=none from nonempty and cases Option; do not leave oracle/minimum hypotheses. Every antecedent used comes from Admissible; retain original goal. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Final.fixed_span_correct
spec.guidance: Use FixedSpan.distance_improvement/witness_improvement and nontrivial_family. For actual Admissible family use recipe support/degree and coefficient0=1; span=2. Do not assume the declared family belongs to the domain. Every antecedent used comes from Admissible; retain original goal. Return tactic lines only without leading by.

spec.name: M6.Final.zero_span_correct
spec.guidance: Combine the accepted ZeroSpan six clauses. Qzero: unfold actualQ, use boundary_trace_zero/character_trace_zero, signature_one, Normalize.divide_scaled and simp. Exact two distinct labels retained. Every antecedent used comes from Admissible; retain original goal. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
